sheets.prompt: Interior concept art for a science fiction exploration game: a dark hall inside a tower of the makers, almost black, a still dark pool filling the floor with no way across, a wall of great twisted roots climbing the far side. At the pool's near edge a lamp in a carved stone socket has just caught: a glass orb of pool water, glowing soft gold, has rolled down a groove through the doorway into the socket, and out of the dark water a line of round moss-covered stepping stones rises glowing toward the roots. A cloaked adult human traveller of ordinary height with a round jade fluid backpack, a little glowing lantern charm at their hip, stands at the edge watching the stones rise, dwarfed by the hall, their light a soft circle round them. Friezes of three lamps over a hull. Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, exquisite fine pen contours, sparse delicate hatching only in shadows, luminous flat pastel gouache colours, deep blue-violet darkness, warm lamp gold, moss green glow, coral glints, restrained cream paper grain, clear readable construction, no lettering. Avoid: photorealism, 3d render, text, watermark, lettering, labels.
